thesis: Marcus Rivera rear-ended the stopped insured and admitted inattention at the scene; his carrier State Farm is a clean recovery target.

supporting_evidence.quote: A blue Toyota Camry struck her from behind.
supporting_evidence.claim: Establishes a rear-end impact on the stationary insured vehicle.

supporting_evidence.quote: Marcus Rivera stated 'I was looking at my phone and didn't see her stop.'
supporting_evidence.claim: Third party made a spontaneous admission of inattention to the responding officer.

supporting_evidence.quote: Rivera cited for following too closely and inattentive driving.
supporting_evidence.claim: Officer issued citations confirming third-party fault.

supporting_evidence.quote: The Camry behind her rolled into her without braking.
supporting_evidence.claim: Independent witness corroborates that the third party failed to brake.

estimated_recovery_basis: Authorized repair estimate of $8,500.00 from Hawthorne Auto Body.
